prompt: Run a doc audit on this project

assertions.description: Reports docs/api-reference.md as a broken link from README.md
assertions.check: report mentions api-reference.md as broken or missing

assertions.description: Reports CONTRIBUTING.md as a broken link from README.md
assertions.check: report mentions CONTRIBUTING.md as broken or missing

assertions.description: Reports CHANGELOG.md as a broken link from README.md
assertions.check: report mentions CHANGELOG.md as broken or missing

assertions.description: Flags Pydantic v1 (in README/roadmap/design-decisions) vs pydantic>=2.0 (in pyproject.toml)
assertions.check: report mentions Pydantic version conflict or discrepancy
report mentions Python version conflict or discrepancy

assertions.description: Notes tech stack info duplicated across README.md, roadmap.md, and architecture/overview.md
assertions.check: report mentions tech stack being duplicated in multiple files

assertions.description: Notes installation instructions duplicated between README.md and getting-started.md
assertions.check: report mentions installation duplication between README and getting-started
